summary: Iran's SSAA cadastral/land-registration systems and Shamim service identity were identified. No anonymous public parcel response with a stable native ID and geometry was verified, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Persian discovery queries are recorded in city-4773-city.json. They identified official SSAA/Shamim systems; general map and secondary procedural results were not treated as parcel service evidence.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official national SSAA host did not respond within the 15-second request limit; no login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS-disable exception used.
Official Shamim host did not respond within the 15-second request limit; no authorized or interactive access was attempted.
Third-party place reference confirms Veys/Weys location context only; it is not cadastral parcel evidence and no geometry was retained.
Secondary Persian documentation describes Shamim as an SSAA cadastral positioning system with organizational access constraints; it is procedural context, not parcel geometry evidence.
